name: Disable Insider Preview Builds
description: Disables Windows Insider Preview builds to keep your system on the stable General Availability channel, preventing unstable updates from affecting gaming or production workloads.

description_i18n.en: Disables Windows Insider Preview builds to keep your system on the stable General Availability channel, preventing unstable updates from affecting gaming or production workloads.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Windows Insider-Vorschau-Builds und hält das System im stabilen Kanal für allgemeine Verfügbarkeit, um instabile Updates bei Gaming- oder Produktivsystemen zu vermeiden.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les builds de prévisualisation Windows Insider pour maintenir le système sur le canal stable Général Availability et éviter des mises à jour instables.

warnings.title: Existing Insider Enrollment
warnings.message: This tweak prevents future enrollment in preview builds but does not uninstall an already installed Insider Preview build. If your device is currently enrolled, you may need to wait for a public release or reinstall Windows

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings are modified until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Sets ManagePreviewBuilds to 0 and BranchReadinessLevel to 32 under HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate Also sets AllowBuildPreview to 0 for legacy compatibility
